messages:
EngOps Bot: heads-up — we just opened a new Dedicated pool in BLR1 (Bangalore) backed by Hyperion-GPUs. Pool name: hyperion-blr1. Initial capacity: 20 instances, 8GB KV-cache config by default. Tags: #dedicated #hyperion #blr1 :tada:
Marina R: nice! what's Hyperion? better/lower cost than H100s?
Samir K: Hyperion is our new vendor-optimized GPU family (marketing name). Rough spec: 96GB VRAM equivalent, optimized for long-context workloads, cheaper watt-per-token. For most gen/chat workloads expect ~15-30% cost improvement vs our baseline H100 pool.
Anna L: any constraints? can teams reserve or is it only burst?
Jules C: initial launch is mixed-mode — 50% reserved for commit (monthly/annual), 50% in burst pool. We recommend teams with steady throughput reserve capacity. Reservation guide below.
Anna L: pinging platform teams that use long-context RAG — will this break KV cache assumptions?
Samir K: default KV config uses 8GB per worker; if you need larger KV cache set model_profile="hyperion-large-kv" in route config. No binary incompatibilities with our runtime.
Marina R: reservation CLI?
Jules C: use the CLI or Console. Example CLI to reserve 4 instances for 30 days:
```
redwood reserve --pool hyperion-blr1 --count 4 --duration 30d --commit monthly
```
Marina R: thanks — what about fallback routing if pool is exhausted?
Samir K: routing policy: requests will failover to hyperion-blr1-compat (a mixed H100/Hyperion pool) then to our standard eu-south-1/h100 fallback per your policy. You can opt into strict routing in the Console to avoid automatic fallback.
EngOps Bot: Note: new billing SKU 'dedicated.hyperion' starts today. Metering granularity is per-instance-hour. Early adopters get an automatic 5% rebate for the first 60 days if you migrate at least one production route.
Infra Oncall: Ops note — Hyperion instances are soft-preemptible in burst windows during BLR maintenance windows. We'll publish the maintenance calendar tomorrow. If you need hard-affinity, reserve commit capacity.
Jules C: Rollout timeline: day 0 — soft open (this announcement). Day 7 — increase to 50 instances if telemetry looks healthy. Day 21 — open full reservation UI for annual commits.
Marina R: who do we contact for performance regressions?
Samir K: tag @Infra Oncall and add the thread to the incident channel with subject: "hyperion-blr1 perf". Also attach a short repro and perf numbers (p95 latency, median tokens/sec).
Anna L: +1 to the repro note. Any known model incompatibilities?
Samir K: none so far. Quantization paths supported: 4-bit and 8-bit profiles. If you hit differences, file an eval with the Optimize team.
Marina R: thanks — will loop in the RAG team. :thumbsup:
Jules C: tiny operational tip — when reserving, use the tag `team=<your-team>` so cost shows up correctly in Console reports.
EngOps Bot: documentation links: https://intra.redwood.dev/dedicated/hyperion-blr1 (internal) and the pool ID is hyperion-blr1-001. API note: model_profile hyperion-default/hyperion-large-kv.
Infra Oncall: deploying initial health checks now; expect a short blip on some monitoring dashboards as agents warm up (not user-facing). Will update here if anything unexpected shows up. :mag:
Marina R: great, appreciate the update everyone.
Samir K: thanks team — please escalate if you see >5% error or >20% latency regression after moving traffic.
